title: 第十一章 猛兽总是独行第十二章 读者老爷们的智慧
lines: 修炼无岁月，半月光阴，如水流逝。
这半个月，林砚一直待在武馆练拳。
演武场上，人不多。
“我就知道林师弟你肯定在，来帮个忙。”
李安抬着一口大锅，林砚见状连忙上前，将大锅给搬在了演武场中心处，这里架起来了一个临时灶台。
林砚看着锅内黑色如膏药状的物质，眼底有着好奇：“李师兄，这是什么？”
“磨皮膏，咱们师傅亲自配制的，专门给你们这些还没一次磨皮的弟子准备的，你没满一个月不用花钱，不然就得交钱才能用。”
这就是磨皮秘药？
入武馆半个月，林砚对武道有些有所了解了。
武者磨皮，讲究三分练七分药。
没有磨皮秘药，光靠苦练，练一年也不如人家涂抹秘药练一个月的效果好。
“师傅定下的规矩是，在酉时之前秘药可以敞开了涂抹。”
李安压低声音：“第一次我不给你抹那么厚，抹完忍着痛去练拳，到申时就差不多吸收完了，冲着还未到酉时，能够再涂抹一次吗，第二次抹厚点，够用到亥时。”
林砚眼睛一亮：“多谢师兄。”
“也是林师弟你勤勉，换个人不一定能够坚持。”李安笑着吩咐：“脱去外衣外裤。”
林砚也不墨迹，脱掉衣服就留下一件裤头，任由李安抓起锅里膏药就往身上抹，膏药接触到皮肤，短短几息一股火辣辣的感觉便是顺着皮肤沁入体内，最后变成了一股灼烧的痛楚。
啪啪！
李安给林砚抹完，拍了下林砚的左右大腿：“行了，去练拳吧。”
林砚将衣服穿上，忍着身体的灼烧感，开始打起劈山拳。
膏药带来的灼烧感起初如野火燎原，让林砚的皮肤阵阵刺痛。
当起手摆开拳架，随着气血运转，这股灼痛感更加的剧烈。
林砚咬紧牙关，强行忍着灼烧之痛，一招接着一招。
一遍劈山拳，两遍劈山拳。
随着一拳一脚认真打出，林砚发现体表那股火辣辣的热力，被内息牵引、揉碎，丝丝缕缕地渗入皮肉之下。
“不愧是秘药！”
林砚眼睛逐渐发亮，免费的秘药，这机会可不多。
下一刻心念一动，动用石腰蛮脊根骨，石腰蛮脊根骨能够提升气血滋长效果，也就能加快吸收磨皮膏的速度。
不远处的李安偶尔瞥来一眼，看到林砚拳势沉稳、呼吸匀长，眼中不由闪过一丝讶异：“第一次用药就能适应得这么快？看来林师弟的这第二次稳了。”
两个时辰后，林砚看着自己光滑的手臂皮肤，朝着大锅再次走去。
这一次李安给林砚抹了厚厚一层，眼皮眨了几下：“林师弟，忍住。”
一切尽在不言中。
足足比先前厚了两倍的膏药抹上去，还没挥舞拳脚，林砚便是感受到了那股灼热的痛感再一次袭来，比先前还要猛烈。
轻轻抬手，更是如烈焰灼烧一般痛苦。
“难怪师傅不在意弟子们用了多少磨皮膏，想多抹，也得身体承受的住。”
自己也是到了身体所能够承受的极限了。
content_en:
Cultivation has no time, half a month passes by like water.
In the past half month, Lin Yan has been practicing boxing in the martial arts gym.
There were not many people in the martial arts arena.
"I knew you must be here, Junior Brother Lin, to help."
Li An was carrying a big pot, and Lin Yan quickly stepped forward and moved the pot to the center of the martial arts arena, where a temporary stove was set up.
Lin Yan looked at the black plaster-like substance in the pot with curiosity in his eyes: "Senior Brother Li, what is this?"
"The dermabrasion cream is prepared by our master himself. It is specially prepared for you disciples who have not yet had a dermabrasion. You don't have to spend money for it for less than a month, otherwise you have to pay before you can use it."
Is this the secret medicine for microdermabrasion?
After entering the martial arts hall for half a month, Lin Yan had some understanding of martial arts.
The martial artist polishes the skin and pays attention to three points of practice and seven points of medicine.
There is no secret medicine for microdermabrasion. Just hard training and practicing for one year will not be as effective as applying the secret medicine for one month.
"The rule set by the master is that the secret medicine can be applied openly before the You hour."
Li An lowered his voice: "I didn't apply it so thickly on you the first time. After applying it, I endured the pain and practiced boxing. By Shen Shi, it was almost absorbed. Since it's not yet You Shi, can you apply it again? The second time, apply it thicker, enough to last until Hai Shi."
Lin Yan's eyes lit up: "Thank you, senior brother."
"Junior brother Lin, you are also diligent. Someone else may not be able to persist." Li An smiled and ordered: "Take off your coat and pants."
Lin Yan didn't do any ink stains, so he took off his clothes and left only his trousers, letting Li An grab the plaster from the pot and apply it on his body. The plaster came into contact with the skin, and in just a few breaths, a burning sensation penetrated along the skin into the body, and finally turned into a burning pain.
Bang bang!
After Li An wiped Lin Yan's face, he patted Lin Yan's left and right thighs: "Okay, let's go practice boxing."
Lin Yan put on his clothes, endured the burning sensation in his body, and began to perform Mountain Splitting Fist.
The burning sensation caused by the plaster was like wildfire at first, making Lin Yan's skin tingle.
When he started to open his fist, the burning pain became more intense as the energy and blood circulated.
Lin Yan gritted his teeth and endured the burning pain, one move after another.
Use Mountain Splitting Fist once, Mountain Splitting Fist twice.
As he punched and kicked carefully, Lin Yan found that the burning heat on the surface of his body was pulled and crushed by the inner breath, and penetrated into the skin.
"It is indeed a secret medicine!"
Lin Yan's eyes gradually brightened. There were not many opportunities to get free secret medicine.
The next moment I thought of it, I used the stone waist spine root bone. The stone waist spine root bone can enhance the effect of qi and blood growth, and can also speed up the absorption of the dermabrasion cream.
Li An, who was not far away, glanced over occasionally and saw Lin Yan's steady fists and even breathing. A trace of surprise flashed in his eyes: "You can adapt to the medicine so quickly for the first time? It seems that Junior Brother Lin is stable this second time."
Two hours later, Lin Yan looked at the smooth skin of his arms and walked towards the cauldron again.
This time, Li An applied a thick layer to Lin Yan and blinked his eyelids a few times: "Junior brother Lin, hold on."
Everything is left unsaid.
After applying the plaster that was twice as thick as before, Lin Yan felt the burning pain coming back again, even more violently than before, before even moving his fists or feet.
Lifting his hand gently, he felt even more painful like a burning flame.
"No wonder the master doesn't care how much dermabrasion cream the disciples use. If you want to apply more, your body has to be able to bear it."
I have reached the limit of what my body can bear.
